title: Metal Fabrication Articles & Buying Guides | NovoTech
meta_description: Buying guides and articles from NovoTech's technicians: band saws, plate rollers, ironworkers, press brake tooling and rebar benders and cutters.
intro: What we explain to customers before they buy — how the machines work, how capacity is rated, which options matter and which do not — written by NovoTech's sales engineers and technicians from years of installing machines in Canada.

articles.title: Band saw buying guide
articles.text: Horizontal and vertical, pivot and double-column, manual to fully automatic: how to choose a metal-cutting band saw, and the blade, coolant and feed details that decide how well it cuts.

articles.title: Plate roller buying guide
articles.text: 3-roll and 4-roll machines, initial-pinch and double-pinch, how capacity is rated, cone bending, crowning, controls and automation.

articles.title: Ironworker buying guide
articles.text: Punching and shearing tonnage, throat depth, stations and tooling: how to size an ironworker for the work in your shop, and why not all tons are equal.

articles.title: Press brake tooling guide
articles.text: Clamping styles, punch and die shapes, V-opening and tonnage, sectioned tools and horns: how to choose press brake punches and dies that fit your machine and your parts.

articles.title: The benefits of using a rebar bender and cutter in construction
articles.text: Why contractors and rebar shops bend and cut on site and in the yard with machines instead of by hand: speed, accuracy, safety and cost.

quote.intro: Have a question the guides do not answer? Tell us about your parts and we will recommend the machine.
